int8_vs_fp32.note: whole-set confusion matrices, no record-level bootstrap, because the quantised model is a deterministic transform of the FP32 one

assumptions.note: No STM32F446 board was available. Latency, peak SRAM and energy are modelled from the layer shapes and the datasheet, not measured on hardware. Parameters, MACs, model size and the FP32-to-INT8 accuracy change are measured.

calibration.monotonicity_note: Temperature scaling is monotone for a single model and cannot change its argmax. The reported classifier is the mean of five seeds' probabilities, and averaging is applied after scaling, so the ensemble argmax can move. It moved on 177 of 49478 DS2 beats.

definitions.conformal_coverage: fraction of beats whose prediction set contains the true class; this is the quantity the split conformal guarantee bounds at 1 - epsilon
definitions.retention: fraction of beats whose prediction set holds at most one class, so the classifier answers instead of abstaining
definitions.coverage: retained for backward compatibility; equal to retention

noise_sweep.injection: added to the raw record before the band-pass filter, then the whole chain of section 6.2 was rerun on the contaminated record

sqi.threshold_rule: second percentile of the index on the DS1 training beats

rules.antecedent: RR ratio to local mean is mid and P-wave presence is high and QRS duration is low
RR ratio to local mean is low and P-wave presence is low and QRS duration is low
RR ratio to local mean is low and QRS duration is high and P-wave presence is low
RR-interval irregularity is high and P-wave presence is low
QRS duration is high and RR ratio to local mean is mid
QRS duration is mid and P-wave presence is high
RR-interval irregularity is low and RR ratio to local mean is low and P-wave presence is low and QRS duration is low
RR-interval irregularity is high and QRS duration is high

teacher.input: 5 s at 100 Hz, single lead replicated into 12 slots, attention pooling, four rhythm descriptors at the head

bandwidth_ablation.note: Scored on the DS1 validation subset only; DS2 is not used here. The student arm topology and hyperparameters are held fixed, so the only change is the upper filter corner.

table1_verified._note: Values read from the primary text of each PDF in '7 missing reference papers'. Every entry names the page-level source sentence or table. 'nr' = the study reports no value for that field. These replace the [[VERIFY]] tags of Table 1 and supply the Figure 7 anchor coordinates.
